title: Data Analyst
description:
Data Analyst needed in Rhyl £19.96 per hr ref OR122846

Full time hours on a temporary basis

  • Key Responsibilities
    • Lead the development, management and continuous improvement of the business systems and Employability CRM.
    • Act as the business lead for CRM development, working with users, ICT teams and software providers to identify improvements and resolve system issues.
    • Develop and maintain performance management frameworks, ensuring accurate reporting against contractual targets, funding requirements and programme outcomes.
    • Design and maintain Power BI dashboards, reports and management information tools for managers, senior leaders and external stakeholders.
    • Coordinate the collection, validation and analysis of service data, ensuring accuracy, compliance and auditability.
    • Produce statutory, contractual and ad-hoc reports for Welsh Government, funders and commissioners.
    • Gather business requirements and undertake business analysis activities including process mapping, options appraisals, business cases and system specifications.
    • Support digital transformation projects through testing, implementation and evaluation of system developments and upgrades.
    • Lead on data quality, governance and information assurance activities.
    • Provide training, guidance and support to colleagues on reporting systems, business intelligence tools and data-driven decision making.

If you are interested in the role, please email your CV to quoting the reference number.

Essential Employment is acting as an Employment Business in relation to this vacancy. Essential Employment is an Equal Opportunities Employer.
